payload.name: ExtractAdditionalHobbiesAfterAlso
payload.description: When a user describes a person's hobbies or interests and later adds another with 'also', 'too', or 'and', extract the additional one as a separate durable fact.
content: During extraction, if a user states a hobby/interest for a person and then in a later turn adds another hobby/interest with 'also', 'too', or 'and', create a separate candidate memory for the additional item.
Do not treat the later item as a paraphrase of the earlier statement or skip it because the topic was already captured; each explicitly named hobby or interest is a distinct fact.

solves: Construction extraction sometimes drops a second hobby or interest when the user adds it in a follow-up turn with 'also' after a previous turn already yielded a memory. The rule forces extraction of each explicitly named attribute separately, preventing incomplete memory profiles. Applies to any conversation where a person's hobbies or interests are enumerated across adjacent turns.
